pages.text: Eleven counters appear in native General statistics and /astral stats: waves fired/hit/kills, melee kills, highest combo, actual critical damage, energy gained/spent, shield and barrier absorption, skills used and perfect parries. Vanilla player statistics persist across death and reconnects. Clients cannot submit counter values. Counters also unlock advancement milestones.
$(bold)Esc → 统计信息 / /astral stats$()$(br2)Use /astral help for controls and /astral stats for counters. Restart the world after configuration changes.
